name: Intuitive Fighting [Psionic]
body:
Your intuition guides your strikes to be more devastating.

Prerequisite: Blind-Fight.

Benefit: To use this feat you must maintain psionic focus. You add your Wisdom modifier to your melee attack rolls instead of your Strength modifier.
